name.zh-Hans: 商汤日日新 Token Plan（免费公测）
name.zh-Hant: 商汤日日新 Token Plan（免费公测）

description.en: Free open beta: the general-credit pool and the Flash-Lite credit pool each provide a limited-time supply of 60,000 credits per rolling 5 hours and 600,000 credits per rolling week; Flash-Lite usage of dedicated credits earns a 1:1 general-credit rebate (rules effective 2026-08-28).
description.zh-Hans: 免费公测中：通用积分与 Flash-Lite 专属积分两个积分池各提供限时放量 60,000 积分/滚动 5 小时、600,000 积分/滚动周的额度；Flash-Lite 消费专属积分按 1:1 返赠通用积分（2026-08-28 起新规则）。
description.zh-Hant: 免费公测中：通用积分与 Flash-Lite 专属积分两个积分池各提供限时放量 60,000 积分/滚动 5 小时、600,000 积分/滚动周的额度；Flash-Lite 消费专属积分按 1:1 返赠通用积分（2026-08-28 起新规则）。

detail.en: SenseNova Token Plan is SenseTime's free open-beta program for its SenseNova (日日新) large-model platform. During the beta, models opened on the platform (e.g. DeepSeek V4 Flash, SenseNova 6.7 Flash-Lite, SenseNova U1 Fast; the list may expand or change) are free through the OpenAI-compatible gateway (https://token.sensenova.cn/v1), and integrations such as WorkBuddy and Claude Code style tools are supported. From 2026-08-28 the platform applies a credits system: accounts carry general credits (shared by all opened models) and Flash-Lite-specific credits (Flash-Lite family only); during the beta each pool provides a rolling 60,000 credits per 5 hours and 600,000 credits per week. A rebate activity also runs from 2026-08-28: every Flash-Lite-specific credit consumed earns 1 general credit back (aggregated by day, settled hourly; rebated credits are valid 30 days and do not count against the rolling limits). Beta benefits and activities may change; confirm on the platform page before relying on them.
detail.zh-Hans: 商汤日日新 SenseNova Token Plan 是商汤科技大模型平台 SenseNova（日日新）的免费公测计划。公测期间，通过 OpenAI 兼容网关（https://token.sensenova.cn/v1）可免费调用平台已开放模型，包括 DeepSeek V4 Flash、SenseNova 6.7 Flash-Lite、SenseNova U1 Fast 等（名单可能扩充或调整），并支持接入 WorkBuddy、Claude Code 类工具。2026-08-28 起平台启用积分规则：账户区分通用积分（所有已开放模型共用）与 Flash-Lite 专属积分（仅用于 Flash-Lite 系列）；公测期间两个积分池各提供限时放量 60,000 积分/滚动 5 小时、600,000 积分/滚动周的额度。同期开启 Flash-Lite 消费返赠活动：每实际消耗 1 点 Flash-Lite 专属积分返赠 1 点通用积分（按自然日汇总、每小时结算，返赠积分 30 天有效，不占用滚动 5 小时/周额度，也不会解锁新模型权限）。公测权益与活动可能随时调整，正式依赖前请以平台页面为准。

freeLimit.en: From 2026-08-28: general-credit pool and Flash-Lite credit pool each give 60,000 credits per rolling 5h and 600,000 credits per rolling week during the beta; Flash-Lite deducts dedicated credits first, then general credits. Rebate activity: 1 Flash-Lite credit consumed returns 1 general credit (settled hourly, valid 30 days, outside the rolling limits). Beta benefits may change.
